tools_description: Shows the catalog of categories, capabilities and adapters.
tools_unknown_action_fix: Use: jgates tools list [--json], jgates tools inspect <instance> [--json], jgates tools matrix [--json], jgates tools prepare --instance <id> [--image <ref>] [--dry-run] or jgates tools config read|validate|write <instance> --file <binding>
tools_missing_instance: Give the instance: jgates tools inspect <instance>.
tools_missing_instance_fix: Use: jgates tools inspect <instance> [--json]. See the instances with jgates tools list.
tools_option_file: Id of the file binding (tools config); never a path.
tools_option_entry: File of a directory binding, as the binding lists it (tools config).
tools_option_from: File with the new text (tools config write); without it, or with -, reads standard input.
tools_option_if_match: Revision (sha256) read before; absent creates a file that does not exist yet (tools config write).
tools_option_allow_invalid: Writes even with a syntax error, by explicit choice (tools config write).
tools_option_not_supported: The option --{name} does not apply to tools {action}.
tools_file_not_binding_id: --file takes the binding id, not a path: {value}
tools_file_not_binding_id_fix: Bindings of the instance: {available}. See them with jgates tools inspect <instance>.
tools_binding_not_found: The binding {binding} does not exist in the instance {instance}.
tools_file_required: Give the binding with --file for tools config {action}.
tools_revision_required: tools config write requires --if-match with the revision read by tools config read.
tools_revision_required_fix: Read the file with jgates tools config read <instance> --file <binding> --json and pass the revision in --if-match (or absent to create a file that does not exist yet).
tools_input_required: Give the new text with --from <file> or through standard input.
tools_input_required_fix: Use --from <file>, or --from - with the text on standard input.
tools_input_unreadable: Could not read the new text: {detail}
tools_input_not_text: The new text is not text (binary or unknown encoding).
tools_document_missing_fix: Create it with jgates tools config write --if-match absent.
tools_document_not_text: The file {path} cannot be shown as text.
tools_conflict: The file of the binding {binding} of {instance} changed since it was read; nothing was written.
tools_conflict_fix: Read again with tools config read, reconcile with the current version and write with the new revision.
tools_unchanged: Nothing to write in {binding}; the content is the same (revision {revision})
tools_option_dry_run: Shows versions and network and stops, downloading nothing.
tools_option_allow_version_change: Accepts pinning a tool version older than the lockfile's.
tools_option_image: Image to pin for a container instance (name:tag or name@sha256:...); default: the lockfile's, otherwise the sidecar's.
tools_prepare_usage: Use: jgates tools prepare --instance <id> [--image <name:tag or name@sha256:...>] [--dry-run] [--no-interactive] [--json]
tools_prepare_dry_run: Simulation: nothing was downloaded or written.
tools_prepare_done: Rules {ref} written to {hash} and pinned in {lock}.
tools_prepare_unchanged: The rules {ref} were already prepared with the same hash ({hash}).
tools_prepare_image_present: Image: {image} (id {id}) is in the container runtime.
tools_prepare_image_absent: Image: {image} is not in the container runtime.
tools_prepare_image_network: Network: docker pull from {hosts}, only because the given image is not in the runtime.
tools_prepare_image_unchanged: The image {image} was already pinned as {pinned} ({version}) in {lock}.
